words.meaning: 未經計劃的；臨時發生的
words.note: 表示事情沒有事先安排或準備。
words.example: We made an unplanned stop at a small village.
words.exampleZh: 我們臨時在一個小村莊停留。

exercises.original: We made a spontaneous stop at a roadside café because the view was beautiful.
exercises.zh: 因為景色很美，我們臨時在路邊咖啡店停下來。
exercises.upgrade: We made an unplanned stop at a roadside café because the view was beautiful.

options.explanation: 看見美景後立刻停車有一點自然反應意味，但 stop 在旅程中更直接是「沒有事先安排」。
because the view was beautiful 表示臨時改變行程，最精確。
通常用於台詞／節目內容，不適合旅程停留。
正式程度和是否事先計劃無關。
表示刻意、經過考慮，和 spontaneous 對比。
表示排練過，不適合旅行停留。

exercises.original: Their spontaneous visit surprised us because they had not called beforehand.
exercises.upgrade: Their unplanned visit surprised us because they had not called beforehand.

options.explanation: 和 had not called beforehand 的臨時性相反。
可理解為臨時作出，但 visit 更自然說 unplanned/impromptu。
沒有事前聯絡，是最直接線索。
visit 不是典型本能反應。
可以是有意拜訪，但 deliberate 不表示沒有計劃。
不適合 visit。

exercises.original: The picnic was spontaneous; we decided to go only an hour before leaving.
exercises.upgrade: The picnic was unplanned; we decided to go only an hour before leaving.

options.explanation: 不涉及安排時間。
decided ... only an hour before 明確表示事先沒有規劃。
不是本能反射。
picnic 可以自然輕鬆，但這不等於沒計劃。
方向相反。
不適合 picnic。

words.note: 表示沒有事先準備，當場進行的活動、談話或表演。
words.example: He gave an impromptu speech after receiving the award.
words.exampleZh: 他領獎後即興發表了一段演說。

exercises.original: After dinner, one of the guests gave a spontaneous speech thanking the hosts.
exercises.zh: 晚飯後，一位客人即興致辭，感謝主人家。
exercises.upgrade: After dinner, one of the guests gave an impromptu speech thanking the hosts.

options.explanation: 表示事先排練，和 spontaneous 相反。
speech + no prior preparation 是最典型搭配。
speech 不是本能反射。
也有突然決定的意味，但對 speech 本身，impromptu 更自然、更中性。
表示已安排。
表示正式化，不表示即興。

exercises.original: The musicians played a spontaneous piece when the audience asked for one more song.
exercises.upgrade: The musicians played an impromptu piece when the audience asked for one more song.

options.explanation: 觀眾臨時要求 encore，當場演出最自然叫 impromptu。
可能音樂家以前演過，但句中重當場臨時加入。
和 audience asked for one more song 不符。
可以是有意演奏，但沒有「臨時即興」資訊。
表演不是純本能反射。
方向相反。

exercises.original: The manager called a spontaneous meeting after the system failed.
exercises.upgrade: The manager called an impromptu meeting after the system failed.

options.explanation: meeting 不會自然以 scripted 描述整體安排。
system failure 觸發臨時會議，是典型 impromptu meeting。
routine meeting 是定期／常規，和突發故障不符。
表示事先安排。
不適合 meeting。
方向相反。

words.note: 表示因突然的衝動或慾望而行動，往往沒有充分考慮後果。
words.example: Buying the expensive watch was an impulsive decision.
words.exampleZh: 買那隻昂貴手錶是一個衝動決定。

exercises.original: Buying the expensive jacket was a spontaneous decision that she regretted the next day.
exercises.zh: 買下那件昂貴外套是一個衝動決定，她第二天便後悔了。
exercises.upgrade: Buying the expensive jacket was an impulsive decision that she regretted the next day.

options.explanation: 不做作不代表欠考慮。
購物決定通常不是本能反射。
expensive + regretted the next day 明確暗示未充分考慮後果。
只適合 speech/performance 等無稿內容。
也合理，但只是沒有計劃；regretted 顯示更強的 impulsiveness。
表示深思熟慮，方向相反。

exercises.original: His spontaneous decision to quit his job came before he had worked out what to do next.
exercises.upgrade: His impulsive decision to quit his job came before he had worked out what to do next.

options.explanation: 沒有先想好下一步就辭職，是典型欠考慮後果的衝動決定。
通常修飾 speech/meeting/performance，不常形容重大人生決策。
不表示決策過程。
辭職可以源於直覺，但句中重缺乏規劃，不是本能防衛反應。
相反。
表示審慎、有分寸，方向相反。

exercises.original: She made a spontaneous purchase at the checkout even though she had not intended to buy anything else.
exercises.upgrade: She made an impulsive purchase at the checkout even though she had not intended to buy anything else.

options.explanation: 不自然形容購買行為。
checkout + not intended to buy 是典型 impulse purchase 語境。
不適合購物。
自然不等於衝動。
表示刻意思考後做出，和句意不符。
謹慎購買與衝動購買相反。

words.note: 表示反應自然、立即，像本能般發生，而不是經過仔細思考。
words.example: Her instinctive reaction was to step back from the edge.
words.exampleZh: 她的本能反應是從邊緣後退。

exercises.original: Her spontaneous reaction was to pull her hand away from the hot surface.
exercises.zh: 她的本能反應是立刻把手從燙熱表面縮回來。
exercises.upgrade: Her instinctive reaction was to pull her hand away from the hot surface.

options.explanation: 反射性動作不是排練結果。
接觸熱表面後立刻縮手，是典型本能／反射反應。
impulsive 通常涉及衝動決策，而不是身體保護反射。
不是事先安排。
不是經過理性思考。
不適合 bodily reaction。

exercises.original: The crowd's spontaneous response was to step back when the barrier moved.
exercises.upgrade: The crowd's instinctive response was to step back when the barrier moved.

options.explanation: 突然危險／移動 → immediate protective response，是典型本能反應。
雖然不是事先安排，但這裡重的是本能，而不是沒有劇本。
用於即興活動／表演，不自然形容群眾防衛反應。
表示有意識考慮後採取。
方向相反。
表示計算後的策略性行動。

exercises.original: His spontaneous fear response made him freeze for a moment.
exercises.upgrade: His instinctive fear response made him freeze for a moment.

options.explanation: fear response 不是典型 impulsive choice。
也可說 natural response，但 freeze 是更具體的本能反應。
fear + immediate freeze 是典型 instinctive reaction。
不適合生理／心理反應。
相反。
表示經過思考。

words.note: 表示表情、反應、談吐或行為自然流露，不顯得刻意或排練過。
words.example: Her laugh sounded natural and warm.
words.exampleZh: 她的笑聲聽起來自然又溫暖。

exercises.original: Her smile was spontaneous and did not look forced for the camera.
exercises.zh: 她的笑容很自然，看起來並不是為了鏡頭勉強做出來的。
exercises.upgrade: Her smile was natural and did not look forced for the camera.

options.explanation: 笑容可以是本能反應，但句中 did not look forced 主要在對比自然 vs 做作。
不形容 smile 的真實自然感。
not forced 是 natural 的直接線索。
不自然形容表情。
和不做作相反。
表示刻意算計，方向相反。

exercises.original: The conversation felt spontaneous, even though the interviewer had prepared some questions.
exercises.upgrade: The conversation felt natural, even though the interviewer had prepared some questions.

options.explanation: even though ... prepared some questions 說明活動並非完全無準備，但互動聽起來不做作。
也可能，但準備問題不代表對話內容沒有任何 script；句中更重「felt spontaneous」。
不適合 conversation quality。
不自然。
表示突然、突兀，不是自然。
表示沒有規律，不等於自然流暢。

exercises.original: His spontaneous laugh made the audience relax.
exercises.upgrade: His natural laugh made the audience relax.

options.explanation: laugh 看起來／聽起來真誠、不做作，最符合語境。
laugh 可以突然，但不通常把 impulsive 當作正面自然笑聲的首選詞。
會讓笑聲顯得刻意。
表示台詞安排，和真實反應相反。
不描述笑聲自然度。
表示有意而為，不是自然流露。

words.meaning: 沒有事先寫稿的；未按劇本的
words.note: 表示說話、訪談、表演或反應沒有按照事先寫好的台詞或腳本。
words.example: The interview included several unscripted moments.
words.exampleZh: 這次訪談包括幾個沒有事先安排台詞的即興時刻。

exercises.original: The actor's spontaneous remarks after the show were not part of the prepared speech.
exercises.zh: 演出後，演員的即興發言並不在預先準備的演講內容中。
exercises.upgrade: The actor's unscripted remarks after the show were not part of the prepared speech.

options.explanation: 也可以很自然，但句中明確說 not part of the prepared speech，焦點是沒有腳本。
remarks + prepared speech 對比，是 unscripted 的典型語境。
可能是一時衝動說出，但原句沒有暗示欠考慮。
發言不是本能反射。
相反。
表示活動時間有安排，不是內容是否有稿。

exercises.original: The interview included several spontaneous exchanges that had not been prepared in advance.
exercises.upgrade: The interview included several unscripted exchanges that had not been prepared in advance.

options.explanation: 和 had not been prepared 相反。
對話臨時產生不等於衝動。
沒有預先寫好／準備內容，最精確。
可能同樣自然，但這裡的明確線索是 preparation。
方向相反。
表示正式化，不是即興。

exercises.original: The programme became more interesting during a spontaneous moment when the host stopped following the prepared questions.
exercises.upgrade: The programme became more interesting during an unscripted moment when the host stopped following the prepared questions.

options.explanation: 主持人偏離問題未必是本能反應。
stopped following the prepared questions 是直接線索。
可能是一時決定，但不一定帶欠考慮意味。
活動可以 scheduled，但這個 moment 本身沒有預先設計。
相反。
他可能有意偏離，但 deliberate 不等於沒有腳本。

falseSynonyms.zh: 隨機的 ≠ 自發的 random 強調沒有規律或選擇模式；spontaneous 強調沒有預先安排。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A spontaneous decision may come from a genuine impulse. A random decision is made without a clear pattern or reason.

falseSynonyms.zh: 突然的 ≠ 自發的 sudden 只表示發生得快，並不說是不是事先安排。
即興創作 ≠ 所有 spontaneous improvised 很接近 impromptu/unscripted，但更常強調當場創作內容或解決方法。
很接近，但常較負面 spontaneous dinner plan 可以很愉快；impulsive purchase 則可能暗示欠考慮。
本能反應 ≠ 一般臨時安排 instinctive 通常是 reaction/response，而不是臨時活動。
不做作 ≠ 一定未經計劃 一段排練過的演講也可以聽起來 natural。
- spontaneous = 自發的（形容詞） - spontaneously = 自發地（副詞）
- spontaneity = 自發性（名詞） - spontaneous = 自發的（形容詞）
